Commentary.Commentary: All is not lost though, the pitch is offering help to the bowlers but India will have to bowl really well to stay in the game here. Join us in a while to see how they go.

There is nothing much to write about the Indian batting apart from KL Rahul, he too was dropped twice in the innings. India were either caught trying to hit out the spinners or going into their shell trying to defend, defend and defend.

"NICE GARY!" That is what Matthew Wade has been chirping all day long and that is the story for India. It has been a 'Lyon' struggle for the Indian batsman who have found short of not just temperament but also skills to adapt to conditions on offer. They have been rolled over for 189 with Lyon taking 8/50. He got good bounce and turn on offer and he made most of it.

OUT! Lyon has 8 wickets! Lands it outside off, Ishant comes forward to defend but ends up clipping it straight off his pads to leg slip who takes the catch easily. Ishant Sharma departs for a duck but those are superb figures for Nathan Lyon, 22.2-4-50-8! These are his best figures in Tests. India bowled out for 189!
Ishant Sharma is the last man in.

OUT! Rahul departs in bizarre fashion as Lyon has 7! Floats it outside off, Rahul looking for the big shot is beaten in the air. The ball lobs in the air towards mid off where the fielder, Renshaw gets under it and pouches it safely. Rahul walks back disappointed, he has missed out on his ton here. Lyon is all smiles as he has taken seven wickets in this Test!
Floats it on the stumps, Umesh comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Umesh is happy to not play his shots and just keep it out.
Short outside off, Rahul cuts it behind point for a single.
Lands it outside off, Rahul goes for the reverse sweep but fails to connect.
Lands it outside off, Rahul goes hard at it but fails to find the gap. He walks away in pain, seems to have hurt himself there.

NOT OUT! Poor review, this time! Floats it on the stumps, Rahul looks to go for the slog sweep but is hit on his body. An appeal from the bowler but the umpire stays put. Smith wants it reviewed. Ball Tracker shows the ball to be missing the stumps with the height on that one. Australia lose a review and KL Rahul stays on.
Australia have reviewed for a LBW chance on KL Rahul. Seems too high, but you never know.
Steve O'Keefe is brought back for a bowl.
Too full outside off, Umesh keeps it out from his crease.
Floats it outside off, Umesh gets forward and pushes it into covers.
Lands it outside off, Umesh comes forward and defends it.
Floats it outside off, Umesh defends it from his crease.
Umesh Yadav is the next man in.

OUT! Brilliant review from Smith! Goes round the wicket to Jadeja, bowls it on middle, Jadeja looks to defend but seems to have missed it. Steven Smith at first slip takes the catch and he joins the appeal from the bowler. The umpire stays put. Smith is confident and goes for the review. The replays confirm that it was not out lbw as there was an edge there. The ball carried through to the slip and that is out. Jadeja has to walk back. A brilliant review from Australia and India sink further. Lyon now has six!
Jadeja is given not out on lbw, Smith is sure though as he also caught the ball. Looks close!
Floats it outside off, Rahul sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Jadeja gets a good stride forward and pushes it into covers.
A tad shorter on off, Jadeja gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Bowls it outside off on a length, swings in late, Jadeja is not interested.
Slants this one down the leg side on a length, Jadeja lets it go through.
Bowls it on a length again, just around off, Jadeja defends it watchfully.
Starts off with a length ball on off, Jadeja defends it from his crease.
Mitchell Starc called back on for a bowl.
Floats it outside off, Rahul gets across and defends it from his crease.
Shorter outside off, Jadeja goes back and cuts it through point for a single.
Outside off, Rahul clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it outside off, Rahul keeps it out from his crease.
Four Byes! Lands it outside off, spins in sharply, Rahul does not get anything on it. Warner dives in vain as the ball goes off the pads and into the fine leg fence.
Fuller on off, Rahul comes down to work it through mid-wicket but gets it off the outer half towards covers.
Comes nicely forward and clips it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Shorter on the stumps, Jadeja goes back and punches it towards short leg.
Bowls it on the stumps, Jadeja covers the line and defends it.
Jadeja hits this one back to the bowler who dives to his left to stop that one.
Lands it outside off, Jadeja comes forward and defends it with an inside edge onto his pads.
Floats it outside off, Rahul pushes it through point for a single.
Lands it on off, Jadeja comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge as well.
Shorter outside off, Jadeja cuts it through backward point. Josh gets across, dives to stop the ball from going through. Two runs taken.
Lands it outside off, bounces more, Jadeja lets it go through.
Ravindra Jadeja is the new man in.
8th five-wicket haul for Lyon in Tests!

OUT! FIVE FOR LYON! Lands it outside off, Saha stays back and looks to defend it from his crease. The ball takes the outside edge and flies to Steven Smith. He fumbles at first but takes it on his second attempt. Five wickets for Nathan Lyon and is pumped up and why not. Australia have the wood over India here.
Floats it outside off, Saha drives it towards mid off from his crease.
Flatter on the pads, Rahul works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, Saha keeps it out with a forward press.
Floats it on the stumps, Saha is right forward as he comes forward to defend it.
Saha dances down the wicket and pushes it towards mid off from his crease.
Flatter on off, Saha defends it from his crease.
Lands it on the stumps, nudged towards the on side for a single.
Floats it on the stumps, Rahul comes forward and defends it.
Lands it on off, Saha stays back and defends it watchfully.
Shorter outside off, Saha goes back to punch but the ball get big on him. The ball lobs towards short extra cover but there was no man there.
Lands it outside off, comes in, Saha is happy to stay back and defends it.
Stays back and nudges this one towards the on side.
Flatter outside off, Saha tucks it towards short leg.
Floats it outside off, Saha looks to sweep but fails to connect it cleanly. The ball rolls along the ground towards short leg.
Goes back and looks to work it through mid-wicket but finds the fielder.
Flatter on the stumps, Rahul punches it off his back foot towards covers.
Flatter on the stumps, Comes right forward to keep it out.
Rahul gets in line and defends it watchfully.
Too full on the stumps, Saha comes down the wicket and pushes it through cover for a single.
Floats it on off, Rahul pushes it through mid off for a single.
Floats it on off, Saha gets in line and defends it.
Wriddhiman Saha is the new man in.

OUT! Ashwin departs, Lyon takes four! Floats it on the stumps, turns in, Ashwin looks to work it through backward square leg but ends up hitting it straight into the hands of David Warner at leg slip. The players appeal but the batsman is walking and India have lost another vital wicket.
Comes right forward and defends it.
Shorter outside off, Rahul tucks it behind square leg for a single as Warner hares after it from leg slip.
Lands it outside off, Ashwin gets well forward to push it to covers for a single.
Shorter outside off, spins in with bounce on Ashwin, the batsman does well to take the bottom hand off the bat and keep it down.
Another probing over from SOK, bowls it around off, Rahul gets over it and defends it.
Floats it outside off, Rahul defends it watchfully into covers.
Rahul gets outside the line and pushes it back down the wicket.
Loopy on off, Rahul comes forward and pushes it back.
Lands it on the stumps, Rahul comes forward and defends it.
Floats it on the pads, Rahul nudges it towards fine leg where Mitchell Starc gets across in time. A couple taken as the throw is fired at the non-striker's end.
Steve O'Keefe to bowl from the other end.
Flatter on off, Ashwin is beaten in the air but he does well to open the face of the bat to get it towards point from his crease.
Lands it outside off, Ashwin comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Rahul gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it through mid on for a single.
Bowls it outside off, spins in, Rahul punches it towards covers.
Lands it outside off, Rahul stays back and defends it off his back foot.
Floats it outside off, Ashwin works it with the spin through mid on for a single.
The players are out in the middle for the final session. KL Rahul and Ravichandran Ashwin are out to bat. Nathan Lyon to bowl post Tea for Australia. Here we go...
... Day 1, Session 3 ....

The Aussie bowlers have kept the pressure going, as they have hardly bowled a loose delivery. With Rahul continuing his fight in the middle, it will be a test of time to see how many more can the Indians pile up against this relentless attack. As we head towards the final session of play, India would want to keep their wickets in check as they look to post a total past the 300-run mark. Join us back in a short while for the final session of play.

Another dominating session for the Aussies where they restricted the Indians to score 96 runs in the last 31.1 overs for the loss of 3 wickets.  Just when it was looking like the Indians are getting back in the game, Lyon sent back Kohli who misread the line and the straighter one completely. Rahane's struggle in the middle continued as he hardly troubled the scorers. The local lads in KL Rahul and Karun Nair were going quite well in the middle but Steve O'Keefe had different plans altogether as he outwitted Karun Nair.
Too full outside off, Ashwin jams his bat out towards point for a single. That's also, TEA, Day 1!
FOUR! Hit on the up! Outside off on a length, Ashwin goes for the drive on the up. The ball goes off the outer half of the bat past backward point for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Ashwin rides the bounce and defends it.
Rahul works it towards third man for a single.
Drives this one through covers for a couple of runs.
Rahul works it towards the mid-wicket region from his crease.
Josh Hazlewood is brough back into the attack for the final over before Lunch.
Way outside off, left alone by Ashwin.
Woah! That was outrageous! Floats it outside off, spinning away a mile, Ashwin is beaten by some distance.
Steve O'Keefe and KL Rahul are having a banter amongst themselves. It would be interesting to see who comes on top?
This one is wide outside off, does not get up at all. Ashwin cannot put bat to ball.
Four Byes! Flatter down the leg side, Ashwin looks to put it through but the ball beats him and the keeper for a boundary.
Ravichandran Ashwin walks out in the middle to replace the outgoing Karun Nair.

OUT! Karun Nair is sold down the river by Steve O'Keefe! Floats it slowly outside off, lures Karun Nair into the push through covers. The batsman obliges with a stride but is beaten in the air. The keeper collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. That was superbly done by the bowler and an enterprising innings from Karun Nair comes to an end.
Floats it outside off, Nair plays inside the line of that one and is beaten all ends up.
Fuller outside off, Rahul drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Nair pushes this one into covers for a quick single. Good communication between the two.
FOUR! Put away! Slips out a full toss on the stumps, attempting the yorker, Nair does not miss out and clips it through backward square leg for a boundary. 150 up for India.
Goes round the wicket.
Slants it across on a fuller length, keeps low but it is wide enough for Karun Nair to leave it be.
Slants it outside off on a length, Nair lets it go through easily.
Fuller outside off, Rahul goes after it and gets it over extra cover for a single.
Beaten, straight to first slip! Lands it outside off, spins away sharply, Karun Nair is beaten on his front foot defence.
FOUR! In the gap! Shorter outside off, Nair rocks on the back foot in time to cut it past the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Lands it outside off, Nair covers the line and defends it.
Karun Nair pushes it into covers from outside off.
Top edge! Floats it outside off, Karun Nair goes for the slog sweep. The ball flies off the top edge towards deep mid-wicket. A couple taken.
Lands it on off, goes away, Karun Nair comes forward and defends it.
Fuller but on leg, Nair clips it towards the on side from his crease.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Nair tucks it through square leg for a single.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Karun Nair ducks under it.
Fuller on the stumps, Nair clips it with his wrists through square leg for a couple of runs.
Slants it outside off on a length, Karun Nair raises his bat and lets it go.
Sprays it wide outside off on a fuller length, Karun Nair lets it go through.
Fuller on the stumps, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Floats it around off, Karun Nair comes forward and defends it.
A bit short, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Floats it on the stumps, Nair gets over it and turns it through square leg for a single.
Stays back and punches it through point for a single.
Floats it on off, Rahul comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Change of ends for Steve O'Keefe!
Fuller in length on off, Nair comes forward and defends it.
Slants it across on a length, Karun Nair swyas out of the way to let it go.
Fuller length on off, Nair punches it back down the wicket. The bowler gets a foot to it and deflects it towards mid off.
FOUR! Slants it on the stumps, Nair gets in line and clips it fine down to the fence. Starc started too straight on that occasion.
Edged! Fuller outside off, Nair comes forward to clip it through mid on but gets a leading edge towards mid off.
On a length on off, Nair gets in line and defends it back down the wicket.
Mitchell Starc is back for a bowl. Can he get another wicket for the Aussies?
Down the leg side, Rahul stays in his crease and defends it in front of the fielder at leg gully.
Tossed outside off, Rahul prods forward to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Short into the stumps, Karun waits for it and works it through the square leg region for a single.
Down the leg side, Rahul clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Full outside off, Rahul clips it towards the mid-wicket region.
Nair gently defends the ball towards the cover region and scampers through for a quick single.
Floated outside off, Nair drives it down the ground towards the mid off region for a single.
Outside off, Rahul pushes it through the point region for a single.
Full on the stumps, Rahul manages to block it.
Full on the stumps, Rahul drives the ball towards the fielder at covers.
Down the leg side, Rahul clips it towards fine leg for a couple.
Floated outside off, Rahul pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Karun Nair prods forward in defence.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Again down the leg side, Rahul manages to get it through the square leg region for a single.
On the pads, Rahul defends it on the leg side.
Outside off, Nair pushes it through the point region for a single.
Spinning in from the line of the stumps, Rahul clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Lands it around off, Nair covers the line and defends it back down the wicket.
Flatter on the pads, Nair gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Nair comes down the wicket and nudges it towards the mid-wicket region.
Floats it on off, Nair comes forward and pushes it into covers.
Lands it on off, Nair comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge which lobs over the silly point fielder.
Floats it outside off, Nair comes forward to defend but does so off the face of the bat after thinking of withdrawing the bat out in time.
Floats it outside off, Rahul covers the line and blocks it.
Floats it outside off, Rahul is watchful as he defends it.
Flatter on the stumps, Nair nudges it through backward square leg off his pads for a leg bye.
Karun Nair is the next man in. Can the local lads turn the tide in India's favour?

OUT! STUMPED! The risk goes against Rahane, this time! Lands it outside off, Ajinkya comes down the wicket to have a go at it. He misses it completely. The keeper fumbles a touch but recovers in time to disturb the stumps. He had to dive to effect the stumping, on that occasion. The batsman is lying on the ground, wondering what went wrong.  He had connected with one previously but this time he was beaten there. The umpire goes upstairs to check and the replays show that Rahane was way out as he tries to reach his crease back with a dive. India are in doldrums, trying to fathom, what is the best way to counter spinners on this deck. An unusual scenario for this Test team.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a stumping appeal on Ajinkya Rahane. It seems like Rahane is struggling.
Rahane gets in line of the ball and defends it.
Floats it outside off, spins in sharply, Rahane fails to clip it through. Shouts of catch it but it fell wide of the short leg fielder but there was no bat there.
Shorter outside off, Rahul cuts it hard towards backward point from his crease.
Rahul gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Lands it outside off, Rahul punches it towards covers off his back foot.
Beauty! Lands it around off, spins away at the last moment to beat the outside edge of the batsman. Rahul was not even close to the ball, lucky to have missed the stumps there.
Lands it on off, Rahul gets over it and defends it watchfully.
Floats it outside off, Rahane drives it through mid off for a single.
Fires it on the stumps, Rahul waits for it and then picks it over backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Flatter on off, Rahul tucks it towards square leg from his crease.
Too full outside off, Rahane pushes it through mid on for a single.
Lands it outside off, Rahane comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Shorter outside off, spins in sharply, Rahane keeps it down with a closed face of the bat.
Shorter around off, Rahul turns it through mid-wicket. Shaun Marsh hares after it and stops it with a dive. There is a fumble and he falls over but no harm done.
FOUR! Gift for Rahane, taken! Low full toss from Steve O'Keefe, Rahane does miss out and clips it wide of the mid on fielder. The timing was too good and he gets a boundary.
Lands it outside off, Rahane gets an inside edge as he comes forward to defend.
Floats it outside off, Rahane comes forward and defends it.
Flatter on the stumps, Rahul turns it towards square leg and Rahane calls him through for a quick single.
Tossed up outside off, Rahane drives it through covers for a single.
Floats it on off, Rahane turns it towards the on side from his crease.
Drinks has been taken.
Floated outside off, Rahul stays in his crease and defends the last ball of the over before drinks.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the pads, Rahul clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.

Dropped! Floated outside off, Rahul goes for the paddle sweep but gets it straight to the fielder at leg slip. Warner cannot hold onto it as it came a bit quicker than he expected. Second life for Rahul.
Floated outside off, Rahul stays in his crease to defend it.
Spinning in from a length outside off, Rahane shuffles across and clips it through the leg slip region for a single.
Rahul prods forward in defence as that's two maidens in a row for Australia.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Rahul gets behind the line of the delivery as he pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller outside off, Rahul prods forward in defence.
Floated outside off, Rahul stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller in the line of the stumps, Rahul defends it well back top the bowler.
Short into the stumps, Rahane stays in his crease and defends it. Maiden over by Lyon.
Spinning in from outside off, Rahane cuts it late towards the fielder at point.
Down the leg side, Rahane lets it through.
Tossed up, Rahane walks down the track and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Rahane drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Spinning in from outside off, Rahane stays in his crease and defends it.
Rahul stays deep in his crease to defend the last ball off the over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short and wide outside off, Rahul cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Floated outside off, Rahul prods forward and defends it towards the fielder at point.
Rahul stays deep in his crease and defends it by getting behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up in the line of the stump, Rahane camps back and guides it towards short fine leg for a quick single.
Change of ends for Steve O'Keefe. The last time he changed ends, he got six wickets. What will happen this time around?
Rahane stays deep in his crease and flicks it off his pads on the leg side for a single.
Rahane gets an outside edge towards the slip region.
Change in field already! A deep mid-wicket in place now.

FOUR! Top shot! Tossed up outside off, Rahane reads the length early as he gets down the track to smack it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Best way to counter spin is attack it, Rahane shows it how.
Flighted outside off and the ball stays low after pitching, Rahane manages to defend it somehow.
Down the leg side, Rahul clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single. 100 up for India.
Tossed up outside off, Rahul lunges forward to defend the ball.
Down the leg side, Rahul clips it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Angling into the stumps, Rahul pokes at it with soft hands through the vacant slip region for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rahul stands tall and defends it well.
Down the pads, Rahul clips it on the leg side. No runs taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahul stays deep in his crease and defends it.

Spinning in from outside off, Rahane tries to defend it but he is totally beaten by the spin. The ball hits the thigh pad and goes straight to the fielder at short leg. The players appeal but the umpire says no.

Huge shout for LBW! Floated outside off, Rahane lunges forward in defence and blocks it with his front pad. The players appeal but the umpire says no. Smith wanted the review but Lyon told him to not go for it.
Rahane clips it on the leg side.
Floated outside off and spinning in, the ball stays low. Rahane stays in his crease and manages to defend it.
Rahane stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Rahul gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it through mid on for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Rahane lunges forward and drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahane shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Rahul leans into the drive and gets it through the cover region for a single.
Square leg in place now, standing in front of the batsman.
Sprayed full on the pads, Rahul clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On the pads, Rahul tries to clip it on the leg side but misses the ball completely. The ball goes onto hit the thigh pad and then ricochets towards the fielder at point.
Angling into the stumps, Rahul drives it towards the fielder at mid on.
Rahane gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it in front of the fielder at short leg.
Spinning in from a length outside off, Rahane dances down the track and blocks it.
Flighted outside off, Rahane lunges forward in defence.
Floated outside off, Rahane shuffles across and gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Rahul gets to the pitch of the delivery as he drives it through the cover region for a single.
Spinning in after pitching in line of the stumps, Rahul shuffles and defends it towards the fielder at leg slip.
Fuller delivery in the line of the stumps, Rahane blocks it away.
Rahane uses his crease to defend it.
Angling into the stumps, Rahane stays in his crease and defends it back to the bowler.
Sprayed on the pads, Kohli clips it through the square leg region for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Rahane gets behind the line of the ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Josh Hazlewood comes back on, replacing Mitchell Starc.

Floated outside off, Rahane punches it through covers for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but the batsman was in. The ricochet does not get them any extra run though. Only a run taken.
Ajinkya Rahane is the new man in. India need a big one from him.

OUT! Bad choice to review! Tossed up outside off, Kohli covers his stumps and tries to leave it. The ball does not spin much and he gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire is quick to rule it out. Kohli is surprised and he consults Rahul for the review. Maybe Rahul said no but Kohli still went for it. The replays show that the ball was pitched outside off, impact was in line and it was going on to hit the timber. So the decision stays and Kohli has to depart. Aussies are on top of the game as they have sent the best Indian batsmen back to the hut.
What happened there? Virat Kohli has left one on the stumps and is given out lbw. He has reviewed it, more in hope it looks like. Let's see.
Kohli leans forward in defence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Floated outside off, Kohli extends his stretch to reach out to it and drive it beautifully through the cover region for a boundary. Top shot to counter spin.

Spinning in from way outside off, Kohli gets across and tries to defend it but he is beaten by the spin. The ball hits him on the thigh pads and goes towards the fielder at short fine leg. The players appeal but the umpire turns it down.
Way down the leg side, Kohli gets his bat on it as he runs it down towards the fine leg region for a single.
Down the leg side, Rahul clips it fine down the leg side to get on the non-striker's end with a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rahul stands tall in his crease  and defends it.
Length ball way outside off, the batsman shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller outside off, Rahul drives it straight to the fielder at point.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Rahul gets to the pitch of the delivery and defends it.
Short outside off, Rahul punches it through covers to keep strike with a single.
Floated outside off, Rahul stays back and defends it towards the fielder at point.
On the pads, Kohli clips it through the square leg region for a single.
3rd Test fifty for KL Rahul!

Down the leg side, Rahul clips it on the leg side for a single. He finally to manages to get a run after a long wait as he adds another fifty to his name. He would like to continue in the middle for as long as possible.
Spinning in with a bit of extra bounce, Rahul manages to defend it with his glove in front of the fielder at square leg.
Rahul lunges forward to defend it.

FOUR! Angling across from a length, Kohli leans forward and drives it elegantly through the cover region to get his first boundary. A bit of risk involved there as Starc makes him play on such a length.
Not comfortable this time! Short delivery outside off, Kohli fancies the cut uppishly but is lucky to not find an edge as the ball flies away to the keeper.
On the pads, Kohli shuffles a bit across and punches it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
GOOD LEAVE! Good length delivery which is nipping away after pitching, Kohli covers his stumps and lets it through.
Fuller delivery outside off, Kohli tries to drive it but ends up blocking it.
Low full toss on the stumps, Kohli manages to block it on the leg side. Terrific delivery to start with to welcome Kohli by Starc.
Floated outside off, Rahul lunges forward to defend the last ball of the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Turning in sharply after pitching outside off, Kohli makes way for it and guides it towards fine leg for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Kohli prods forward in defence.
Flighted outside off, Rahul reaches to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards long on for a single.
Floated outside off, Virat drives it through the mid on region to get off the mark with a single.
Back of a length delivery into the body, Rahul defends it in front of the fielder at short fine leg.
Mitchell Starc has been warned for running on the danger area on the wicket. First official warning for him, one more of those and he can't bowl in this innings.
Angling in the pads, Rahul clips it through the mid-wicket region and calls for a single. Kohli is quick to send him back.
Good length delivery into the stumps, Rahul pushes it back to the bowler.
Angling into the stumps, the batsman defends it towards the fielder at point.
Angling across from a length outside off, Rahul stays in his crease and defends it.
Low full toss outside off to start with for Starc, Rahul blocks it out towards the fielder at point.
Mitchell Starc to bowl from the other end.
Floated outside off, Kohli covers his stumps but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

The players are back out in the middle. Virat Kohli is the new man in. He will join KL Rahul at the crease. The Australians will be delighted and pumped up with the wicket of Pujara. Nathan Lyon to complete his over...
... Day 1, Session 2....

Rahul has been living dangerously in the middle and the visitors are imposing pressure on the hosts. It would need a couple of good partnerships from the home team as they look to stabilize the ship. Australia, on the other hand, will want to keep picking up wickets to trouble the opposition. Join us in a short while for the post lunch session which would be a very important one in the context of the game.

A session dominated by the Aussies where they kept bowling probing lengths throughout the first session. Starc started off really well as he sent back Mukund in his very second over by bowling a low full toss. Rahul and Pujara stuck in the middle and kept ticking where the former did bulk of the scoring. Just when it was looking like that the Indians would bounce back in it with a stable partnership, Lyon struck just in time before lunch to send Pujara back in the pavilion.

OUT! A soft dismissal! Lyon lands it outside off, the ball once again bounces and spins in sharply. Pujara gets an inside edge which lobs towards short leg off his pads. Peter Handscomb takes the catch and appeals. Pujara starts walking and that is a soft dismissal really. There was a pattern developing - with Lyon hitting that length consistently and this time Pujara got an inside edge which was gobbled by the fielder. So a big wicket for Australia, it tilts the session in favour of the visitors? May be.
Lands it outside off, Pujara is happy to defend it coming forward.
Outside off, Pujara comes forward and pushes it into covers.
Lands it outside off, spins and bounces more, Pujara comes down the wicket and defends it into the ground off his body.
Floats it outside off, Pujara defends it watchfully from his crease.
Pujara tucks this length ball through backward square leg for a single.
Nicely done! Shorter ball going across Pujara, the batsman has picked it early and gets out of the way in time. That was nicely done by Che. Starc has a word with him. All smiles.
Bowls a bouncer on middle and leg, Pujara ducks under it in time to let it go through.
Outside off on a length, Pujara comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Pujara stays in his crease and defends it from his crease.
Loose! Fuller outside off, going further away. Pujara is lured into the drive. The ball beats the bat. India will not want to lose wickets like that.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara comes down and clips it through mid on for a single.
Leg slip in place for Pujara.
Floats it outside off, Rahul looks to sweep it but seems to have missed it. The ball lobs off towards short fine leg. Smith cannot reach it running after it from first slip. A single taken.
Floats it outside off, spins in sharply, Pujara gloves it with the turn through backward square leg for a single.
Shorter outside off, Pujara punches it towards Shaun Marsh at short mid-wicket.
And once again, quick spin from outside off forces Pujara to stay in his crease and defend it.
Floats it outside off, Pujara thinks of dancing down first but then defends it from his crease.

FOUR! Makes most of the gift! Starc dishes out a low full toss outside off, Rahul does not miss out this time and puts it away with a nice front foot stride into the cover drive. Starc had bowled quite a few of those earlier but Rahul had missed out on them.
Back of a length outside off, Rahul rides the bounce and defends it watchfully.
Rahul gets in line and defends it.
Shorter in length, Rahul hops to defend that one. He takes the bottom hands off the bat.
Brings this one into the batsman, Rahul gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Shorter outside off, Rahul defends it watchfully.
Rahul looks to play a reverse sweep but gets it off his body towards short fine leg for a run. That actually went off his shoulder and helmet after hitting the back of the bat.
50-run stand between KL Rahul and Cheteshwar Pujara. It's been a steady phase of play for the Indians.

FOUR Byes! That's beaten everyone! Floats it outside off, keeps low, Rahul is beaten as he looks to defend this off his crease. That really kept low and beat both the batsman and the keeper and ran down into the fence for a boundary. Byes signaled.
Floats it outside off, spins in sharply, Pujara gets an edge as he looks to work it through backward square leg. A single taken.
Shorter outside off, Pujara punches it off his back foot.
A repeat of the previous delivery, Pujara is happy to defend this way to lunch here.
Floats it outside off, Pujara comes down and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter length angling across, Rahul picks it early and gets out of the way in time.

Top bowling here! The two short ones meant the weight was back, Starc now bowls the fuller one outside off, Rahul is lured into the drive. He gets an inside edge that goes back onto his pads. Rahul needs to play through to lunch here, he seems to be struggling getting into good batting positions.
Keeps it short on the body, Rahul is cramped for room and tucks it towards mid-wicket.

What happened there? Bowls it shorter around leg, Rahul is ages early into the shot. The ball goes off the leading edge and almost carries through to the mid-wicket fielder who came running in towards square leg to catch that one. Good bowling, Starc!
Fuller outside off, left alone by KL Rahul.
Slanting on a length around off, Rahul stays back and defends it.
Mitchell Starc is called back into the attack.
Tossed up outside off, Rahul gets outside the line to sweep but fails to make any connection. A stifled appeal for lbw but that was always hitting him outside the line. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Lands it outside off, Rahul gets forward and defends it.
Floats it outside off, spins in, Rahul defends it watchfully towards short leg.
FOUR! Cheeky! Bowls it outside off, Rahul gets outside the line and paddles it over the keeper for a boundary. That went off the top edge of the bat.
Floats it outside off, gets good bounce, Rahul is back and he turns it towards the on side.
Shorter on the stumps, worked through square leg for a single.
As we speak about him. Smith introduces Nathan Lyon into the attack but to replace Steve O'Keefe.

Extra bounce! Outside off on a length, the ball spits on Rahul who is coming forward to defend that one. Rahul is taken back as he takes the bottom hand off the bat but that really rose on him. Must have hit a crack.
Nathan Lyon is warming up. Will it be spin from both ends?
Fuller length on off, Rahul gets across and pushes it back down the wicket.
On a length around off, Rahul is happy to defend it watchfully.
Back of a length outside off, Pujara guides it towards point off his crease for a single.
Fuller outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it towards mid off.
Shorter outside off, Pujara lets it go watchfully.
Landed outside off, Rahul is right forward to defend that one.
Flatter on the stumps, Rahul is waiting in his crease and defends it watchfully.
Pujara works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Sweeper cover comes in for Pujara.
Fuller on off, Pujara comes down and clips it towards mid on from his crease.
Tossed up outside off, Rahul drives it through covers for a single. That brings up the fifty for India. It has been hard work!
Outside off on a length, keeps a touch low, Rahul goes back and guides it down to third man for a single.
Slanting on the pads, Rahul clips it towards mid-wicket where the fielder dives and stops the ball to his right.
Fuller outside off, Rahul comes forward and pushes it into covers.
Angles it on a length around the stumps, Rahul gets across and defends it towards the mid-wicket region.
Hurls it on a length, on off, keeps a tad low, Rahul does well to keep it out.
Awkward bounce! Bowls it on a length just around off, gets extra bounce, Rahul does well to get in line and defends it.
Mitchell Marsh will bowl his first over of the day.
Shorter outside off, Pujara guides it towards point from his crease. Another maiden, this time for Steve!
Floats it on the stumps, Pujara defends it from his crease.
This one is around off, Pujara is happy to defend it watchfully.
Fuller on off, Pujara comes down and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Waits for this one and nudges it towards short fine leg does Pujara. He wants a single but is sent back.
Floats it on off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Placed! Too full outside off, Rahul gets forward and guides it neatly behind backward point for a boundary. He has got a start, a life and needs to make it count for himself!
Angles it on a length, Rahul covers the line and defends it towards the mid-wicket region.
Pujara works it down the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Neatly done! Fuller, looking for the yorker but is too straight. Pujara clips it through the fine leg region for a boundary.
A harmless length ball way outside off, no shot offered by Pujara.
Shorter on the body, Rahul tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Drives it towards point from his crease for a single.
Rahul does not read this flatter one and jams it out at the last moment.

Dropped! Floats it outside off, Rahul is again coming forward to drive it through the line but ends up hitting it in the air towards short cover. Peter gets his left hand to it but could not hold onto it. That was a tough reflex catch to take and these normally stick. Smith has his hands on his head, Rahul was beaten in the air on that occasion. Poor Peter, he had taken a couple of stunners in the last game but couldn't pull this off.
Fuller outside off, Pujara comes down the wicket and drives it through mid off for a single.

Floats it outside off, Rahul pushes at it without quite going forward. There is a slight hesitation but they eventually take the single as the fielder at covers had fumbled a touch. David Warner had dived but could not stop the ball.
Shorter on middle, Pujara goes back and works it through backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Good timing! Fuller outside off, Rahul looks to drive it from his crease. The ball goes off the inner half through mid on but the timing is still good enough to earn him a boundary.
Fuller outside off, tempting the drive, Rahul is not lured into it and leaves it all alone.
On a length outside off, Rahul presses forward and defends it with an angled face of the bat. The ball goes towards point from his crease.
Brings this one from outside off, Rahul covers the line and defends it back down the wicket.
Runs in from wide of the crease, into the stumps, Rahul is right forward as he defends it watchfully.
Bowls it on a length around the stumps, Pujara leans into it and clips it towards mid on and takes off for a quick single. There is a shy at the striker's end but no harm done for India.
Drinks break! A good first hour for the visitors. They have been disciplined and not allowed India to not get away from them.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Rahul prods forward and defends it.
Angling into the stumps, Rahul gets behind the pitch of the delivery to defend it.
Floated outside off, Rahul gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards mid off.
Rahul dances down the track and blocks it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Down the leg side, Pujara clips it through the square leg region for a single.
FOUR! PIERCED! Fuller delivery outside off, Rahul drives it powerfully through the point region for a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Rahul gets a leading edge which goes towards the bowler.
Sprayed on the pads, Rahul clips it beautifully through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Angling into the pads, Rahul prods forward in defence.
Leg bye! Short delivery into the body, Pujara stands tall but cannot defend it. The ball hits him on his chest and goes towards the fine leg region for a leg bye.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Rahul dances down the track decides to defend it.
Floated outside off, Rahul drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, Rahul drives it towards the fielder at covers.

Shout for LBW! Angling down the leg side, Rahul camps back in defence but is beaten by the lack of spin as the ball hits the pads. The players appeal but the umpire is unmoved. The Aussies think of a review but do not go for it as Steve O'Keefe feels that the ball was going surely down leg.
Good length delivery outside off, Pujara is not comfortable of the length as he edges it towards the fielder at gully.
Fuller delivery outside off, Pujara opens the face of the bat and guides it towards the fielder at point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Pujara stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Pujara drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Pujara gets behind the line of the delivery to defend the ball.

Angling into the pads, Rahul works it square of the wicket on the leg side and calls for a quick single. Shaun Marsh from mid-wicket covers it quickly and has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. A single is taken.
A change of ends for Josh Hazlewood!
Pujara gets to the pitch of the ball as he defends the last ball of the over.
Short delivery into the stumps, Pujara stays deep in his crease and punches it back to the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Pujara defends it from the inner half of the bat in front of the fielder at short fine leg.
Fuller delivery just outside off, Pujara prods forward in defence.
Tossed up outside off, left alone by Pujara.
Too full outside off, Rahul jams it on the pitch. End of another good over by Starc.
Short delivery into the body, Rahul stays deep in his crease and defends it on the leg side.
Length delivery angling across, Rahul covers his stumps and leaves the ball alone.
Full delivery outside off, Rahul prods forward and defends it.
Down the leg side, Rahul lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Full toss outside off, Rahul gets it towards the mid-wicket region after hitting it from the inner half of the bat.
Tossed up outside off, Rahul drives it firmly on the off side and the ball hits Handscomb at silly point. The ball ricochets towards the fielder at point for a single.
Floated up, Rahul dances down the track and does well to block it.
Pujara gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it towards long on for a single.
Floated up in the line of the stumps, Pujara prods forward and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara dances down the track and drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Tossed up delivery in the line of the stumps, Pujara stays in his crease and defends it.
Time for spin! Steve O'Keefe is the new bowler for Australia.
Dug in short! Rahul sways away from the line of the delivery to let it through to the keeper.
Full toss delivery angling into the stumps, Rahul clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple. Similar delivery to the one which took Mukund by surprise.
Short delivery into the body, Rahul stays tall in his crease and defends it in front of the fielder at short leg.
Leg bye! Fuller delivery on the pads, Pujara tries to clip it but gets it off his pads towards the fine leg region. The players sneak in a single. A leg bye is taken.
Way down the leg side and swinging further down, Pujara is undisturbed. Wade makes a fine diving save to stop the ball.
Back of a length delivery angling across, Pujara lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Angling into the stumps from a length, Rahul gets behind the line of the delivery to defend the last ball of the over. Another maiden from Josh.
Length delivery outside off, Rahul shoulders his arms to it.
Good leave! Short delivery angling across, Rahul gets away from the line of the delivery as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Down the leg side, the ball kept a bit low as Rahul clips it from the bottom end of his bat towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Angling into the stumps, Rahul stays in his crease and defends it well.
Length delivery outside off, left alone by Rahul.
Another short delivery to end the over. Pujara lunges forward and adjusts as he camps back to stand tall and defend it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Pujara drives it towards mid off. Warner makes a good stop to save the boundary.
Well left! Back of a length delivery similar to the delivery on which he got out in the first match. Pujara read the length well as he dropped his shoulders well in time to evade it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Pujara shoulders his arms to it.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Angling into the stumps, Pujara stays in his crease and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Short delivery angling into the body, Rahul thinks of playing it but decides to leave it at the last moment.
Length delivery outside off, Rahul plays it through point and calls for a single. Pujara sends him back.

FOUR! LUCKY! Good length delivery pitched outside off. The ball nips away after pitching. Rahul goes to poke at it and finds an outside edge which goes through the vacant third slip region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahul defends it.
Angling into the stumps, Rahul stays in his crease and defends it.
Full delivery outside off, Pujara tries to jam it but couldn't get it off the middle of the bat. End of a brilliant over by Starc.
Cheteshwar Pujara walks in, early again. India's opening woes continue. There is a short leg in place for him. It has gone a bit dark, may be resembles the mood of Mukund?

OUT! Mukund departs on a duck! Full toss on the pads, Mukund tries to clip it on the leg side. He is beaten by the pace completely as the ball hits him on the pads. The players appeal in unison and the umpire has ruled it out. Mukund has a talk with Rahul but the latter is unimpressed about the idea of a review. Starc draws first blood in this encounter. India have lost their first wicket.
Full delivery just outside off, Mukund manages to defend the nearly yorker length delivery.
Short delivery into the body, Rahul did not expect that bounce as he manages to clip it towards the fielder at fine leg for a single. The ball went off the gloves.
Full delivery angling into the stumps, Rahul stays in his crease and defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery way outside off, Rahul is least concerned about that one as it is way wide.
Just two slips in place now!
On the pads this time, Mukund tries to clip it but fails to make contact. The ball hits him on the thigh pad and Hazlewood ends with a maiden.
Angling across from a good length, Abhinav covers the stumps and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Mukund shoulders his arms to it.
Angling across on a length, Mukund shuffles across and pushes the ball towards the fielder at covers.
Way down the leg side, Mukund stays in his crease as he lets the ball through to the keeper.
Fuller delivery angling across, Mukund covers his stumps and drives it towards mid on.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end. A similar field for him.

FOUR! Cheeky! Fuller delivery outside off, Rahul leans towards the ball and opens his face of the bat to guide it through the gully region for a boundary. It came off the outer half of the bat, Starc has a wry smile. Good start for India.
Short delivery into the body, Rahul stands tall and defends it somehow. That ball got big on him.
Fuller delivery just outside off, Rahul stays in his crease and drives it through the wide of mid off region for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, left alone as it was not going to disturb the batsman.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahul covers his stumps and lets it go through to the keeper.

FOUR! What a start for India! Wide half volley outside off, Rahul leans into the drive and plays it elegantly through the cover region. He made it look really easy to get the first runs on the board. It was a boundary the moment it hit the bat.

The Indians have a new opening pair in the middle as KL Rahul and Abhinav Mukund walk out to the pitch. It will be a crucial session of cricket as both teams would look to impose themselves. Mitchell Starc will begin the proceedings with the ball for Australia. Three slips in place for him. Here we go...
The players are out in the middle for the National Anthems.
Australia XI- Matt Renshaw, David Warner, Steven Smith(c), Shaun Marsh, Peter Handscomb, Mitchell Marsh, Matthew Wade(wk), Mitchell Starc, Steve O'Keefe, Nathan Lyon, Josh Hazlewood.
India XI - Abhinav Mukund, Lokesh Rahul, Cheteshwar Pujara, Virat Kohli(c), Ajinkya Rahane, Karun Nair, Ravichandran Ashwin, Wriddhiman Saha(wk), Ravindra Jadeja, Umesh Yadav, Ishant Sharma.

Steven Smith - Reckons that the first Test is always important and they have successfully won it. Addresses that he cannot underestimate the Indians who will be looking to bounce back in the contest. Seems really happy after the first game where his team played good cricket and proved a point.

Virat Kohli - Smiles as Sanjay Manjrekar reckons that India are back to winning ways as they have won the toss. Kohli sounds really happy as he opts to bat first and looks to score heavily as the wicket seems batting friendly. Seems optimistic about the game as they have bounced back even in the past and would love to do so again. Mentions that when they lost at Galle against Sri Lanka, they had found that they lacked intent and adds that the boys will come out with a lot more intent in this game. Ends by saying that the Bangalore wicket has always helped the pacers when they have bowled on a better length.

TOSS - India win the toss and opt to bat first! Two changes for India, Murali Vijay is injured and replaced by Abhinav Mukund. Karun Nair comes in place of Jayant Yadav, so India have brought in an extra batsman to strengthen the side. Australia had already announced an unchanged XI.

Australia announced an unchanged XI which shows how confident they are, not wrongly too. They have done well to put pressure on India and will know they can do the unthinkable, by retaining the Border-Gavaskar trophy by winning this Test. The Indian side will be hurting and itching for a comeback. It is only the second time Virat Kohli has lost the opening Test in the sub-continent, they came back against Sri Lanka to win the series 2-1 but Australia are a different proposition. Everyone can talk about the one bad game, but it takes performance to actually put it past you. There is a lot at stake, expect a cracker of a game!

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the 2nd Test between India and Australia at M.Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru. What we are about to witness today is why the game of cricket is so popular between us - Australia are going into a Test in India with a 1-0 lead. It does not matter if the fans, selectors, experts of the game give you a chance or not, the game does. Australia made the most of it and caught India napping in the first Test of the series. The pitch again will be the one in question as it looks for now like a turner which may be a better wicket to bat on than the one in Pune.
